where: Sunken Solarium (the drowned sun-garden ruin, West) + the Old Light tower floors (Pearlmoor)
mood: Remembered Summer: stored daylight glowing up through the water - warm, nostalgic, everything in the past tense; the first real warmth since the south.
core_styles: G major with a wistful borrowed minor chord
warm singing pulse-wave lead whose phrases rise then sigh down a step
rolling plucked harp arpeggios of broken major triads like sunlight rippling on water
slow round synth bass moving root to fifth
very soft brushed kick and faint hi-hat like water lapping
nostalgic, sun-warmed, bittersweet remembered-summer ruin theme

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a glowing entrance: a shimmer of harp arpeggios rising like light through water, a soft pad swell, and the lead's first warm rising leap held over the chord, settling into the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the remembered-summer melody, hummable and tender: a radiant rising leap then a sighing step down, harp rolling underneath, brushed pulse}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again with a soft bell counter-line glinting above it and the strings a little fuller}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the borrowed minor turn - E minor and C minor colours, longer held notes as if remembering a summer that ended, drums drop to a soft heartbeat, then a gentle lift back toward the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the warm melody returns in full, harp and pad glowing; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme, no ending}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
